title: HyMod-Client
description: Client-side extension for HyMod Runtime servers. Enables custom blocks, items, entities, and dynamic resources.
body:
# HyMod Client

HyMod Client is the client-side component of the HyMod ecosystem, providing cross-platform features and enhanced gameplay functionality for servers powered by HyMod.

Designed to work alongside HyMod-compatible servers, HyMod Client extends Minecraft through custom networking, synchronized content, improved interactions, and features that would otherwise be difficult or impossible to implement consistently across Java Edition and Bedrock Edition.

## Features

* Enhanced multiplayer functionality
* Cross-platform compatibility support
* Custom content synchronization
* Additional gameplay mechanics
* Seamless integration with HyMod-powered servers
* Lightweight and modular design

## About HyMod

HyMod is a cross-platform modding platform that aims to unify Minecraft Java Edition and Bedrock Edition under a single development ecosystem. By combining server-side logic, client-side extensions, resource packs, behavior packs, and compatibility technologies, HyMod enables developers to create experiences that work across both editions with minimal duplication of effort.

## Requirements

This mod is intended to be used with servers running the HyMod platform. Some features may be unavailable when connected to non-HyMod servers.
